appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Additional Promotion Weeks: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
Data points are light blue circles with black text labels.
Data point labeled 'Week 7' is located at approximately (30, 65).
Data point labeled 'Week 8' is located at approximately (40, 105).

printed_facts.fact: Data point labeled 'Week 9' is located at approximately (50, 130).
Data point labeled 'Week 10' is located at approximately (60, 150).
Data point labeled 'Week 11' is located at approximately (70, 160).
The chart displays a positive correlation between advertising spend and sales across the weeks shown.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the promotion-week dashboard and choose a budget planning decision.
The dashboard chart shows advertising spend vs. sales for weeks 7 through 11.
The decision options are: 'Hold and request full-data analysis', 'Approve broader ad spend increase', or 'Decline budget increase for upcoming promotions'.
